nodes.text: Open your own Draenor Engineering recipes and select Gearspring Parts.

recovery.text: If the recipe is missing, switch expansion tiers and clear recipe filters. Skill level alone does not prove the recipe is learned.

recoveryCases.text: If the recipe is missing, switch expansion tiers and clear recipe filters. Skill level alone does not prove the recipe is learned.
Open your own Draenor Engineering recipes and select Gearspring Parts.

nodes.text: Craft Gearspring Parts when its observed cooldown is ready. Gather the listed materials and tools first; use the in-game Craft button yourself.
nodes.details:
Open your own Draenor Engineering recipes.
Craft Gearspring Parts when available. Materials: 15 True Iron Ore, 15 Blackrock Ore / 10 True Iron Ore, 10 Blackrock Ore. Tools: Anvil.
